description: Flask Bones web application with 12 Snyk Code findings spanning command injection, unsafe deserialization, hardcoded credentials, open redirects, path traversal, and insecure cookie attributes.

vulnerabilities.description: The diagnostics form passes an untrusted host to a shell command through subprocess.check_output (Snyk: python/CommandInjection, CWE-78).
The abuse-investigation form passes an untrusted host to a shell command through subprocess.check_output (Snyk: python/CommandInjection, CWE-78).
An unauthenticated draft query parameter is base64-decoded and passed to pickle.loads (Snyk: python/Deserialization, CWE-502).
A client-controlled list preferences cookie is base64-decoded and passed to pickle.loads (Snyk: python/Deserialization, CWE-502).
The database seed command creates an administrator with a hardcoded password (Snyk: python/NoHardcodedPasswords, CWE-798/CWE-259).
The test suite embeds the administrator password in source code (Snyk: python/NoHardcodedPasswords/test, CWE-798/CWE-259).
The login route redirects to an unvalidated next query parameter (Snyk: python/OR, CWE-601).
The email-verification route redirects to an unvalidated next query parameter (Snyk: python/OR, CWE-601).
The self-service report export passes an untrusted filename to a file open operation without a containment check (Snyk: python/PT, CWE-23).
The user report export passes an untrusted filename to a file open operation without a containment check (Snyk: python/PT, CWE-23).
The list preferences cookie is set without the HttpOnly attribute (Snyk: python/WebCookieMissesCallToSetHttpOnly, CWE-1004).
The list preferences cookie is set without the Secure attribute (Snyk: python/WebCookieMissesCallToSetSecure, CWE-614).
